title: What people frame, iii
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Monday: a child's drawing — a house, a tree taller than the house, a dog with too many legs. The father says nothing the whole time. Wood doesn't either.

panels.composition: The counter. A FATHER in a mill jacket. A crayon drawing, flat, no bag. He sets it down and steps back.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, xerox grain, stark black spotting, a man in a faded mill jacket setting a child's crayon drawing on a frame-shop counter and stepping back, a young clerk looking at it, no words

panels.composition: The drawing: a house, a tree taller than the house, a dog with six legs, a yellow sun in the corner. A name at the bottom in a child's letters.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, xerox grain, stark black spotting, close-up of a child's crayon drawing of a house with a tree taller than it, a six-legged dog and a sun in the corner
image.notes: Name at the bottom: reserved — draw it as three or four child-letters, not readable.

panels.composition: Wood cutting the mat. The father standing exactly where he stood. Neither speaks. The clock.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, xerox grain, stark black spotting, a young man cutting a mat while a man in a mill jacket stands motionless by the counter, a wall clock, silence, no words

panels.composition: The framed drawing in the father's hands. He looks at it. He nods once, at Wood, not at the drawing. Goes.
panels.caption: Monday.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, xerox grain, stark black spotting, a man in a mill jacket holding a framed child's drawing and giving a young clerk one nod, no words
image.notes: No balloons in the strip. The only silent one in the arc.

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: Silent. 'Framed by a father who says nothing.' Wood doesn't either. The mill jacket: the reader may think of 2005.
